verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an official JavaScript SDK for tracking events and sending them to destinations, with plugins for loading SDK features on demand. Marketing material refers to instrumenting a RudderStack SDK, but the evidence covers only that one language and gives no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond JavaScript (server-side and mobile languages), SDK reference depth such as typed clients for the management APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: RudderStack's JavaScript SDK lets you track customer event data from your website and send it to your specified destinations.
Load specific SDK features on demand using plugins.
Instrument one RudderStack SDK and automatically send standardized data to hundreds of destinations
